key_impacts: Nuclear fuel melted inside the reactors at Fukushima Daiichi.
Coolant water became extremely contaminated and leaked into the reactor building basement.
Large on-site tanks store accumulated contaminated water after the accident.
evidence_snippets: Large-scale nuclear disaster at the TEPCO-operated Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, directly caused by the March 11, 2011 earthquake and tsunami.
Operators are cooling the nuclear fuel that melted inside the nuclear reactors due to the accident.
Coolant water becomes extremely contaminated, leaks into the basement; the site is packed with tanks containing the contaminated water.
missing_information: Impact numbers and detailed casualty figures not provided
Exact timeline of reactor meltdowns not specified
Directly impacted off-site settlements not listed
